_meta.title: I Simulated A Dunkleosteus In The Modern Ocean, It Was Brutal
_meta.style: Spinosnack — prehistoric-creature AI simulation, 2nd-person POV survival arc
_meta.pipeline: ChatGPT photoreal still -> LTX i2v -> ffmpeg render -> teal grade -> verify
_meta.grade: unified cold teal-blue deep ocean (see NEXT_SESSION teal post-pass)
_meta.still_style_suffix: photorealistic underwater nature documentary, cinematic, cold teal-blue deep ocean, volumetric god-rays, drifting particles, shallow depth of field, IMAX, 16:9, no text, no watermark
_meta.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra fins, six eyes, cartoon, illustration, text, watermark, logo, human face, jpeg artifacts, warping, melting
_meta.notes: 18 hero shots covering 0-161.9s; ~5-9s cuts. Long beats (sh07, sh12, sh13, sh14, sh16, sh18) get split into 2 edit beats via Ken-Burns/loop or a stat-card hold. Stat-card beats flagged.

shots.still_prompt: Extreme close-up of the bladed self-sharpening bony jaw plates of a Dunkleosteus, no teeth, edges honed like a guillotine, poised in cold dark teal water, a single glint of light along the cutting edge
shots.i2v_prompt: the bony blades snap shut once, hard and fast, a glint races along the cutting edge, particles jolt outward

shots.still_prompt: Macro detail of two interlocking blades of bone inside an armored placoderm mouth, ridged self-sharpened bone texture, no teeth, suspended in teal gloom
shots.i2v_prompt: slow push-in along the bone blades, faint shimmer of light, drifting particles

shots.still_prompt: A Dunkleosteus bony jaw shearing a smaller silver armored fish clean in half underwater, bone slicing through, scattering scales and particles, dramatic
shots.i2v_prompt: the jaw closes through the fish, debris and scales burst outward, motion blur

shots.still_prompt: Full body of a giant armored Dunkleosteus looming out of deep teal gloom, heavy bony head plates, dominant in scale, raking god-rays
shots.i2v_prompt: the giant glides slowly forward to fill the frame, subtle camera push-in

shots.still_prompt: Lone Dunkleosteus silhouette swimming away into deep blue-black darkness, vast empty ancient ocean, melancholic, fading into the gloom, dust motes
shots.i2v_prompt: the silhouette recedes and dims into the dark, slow melancholic drift

shots.still_prompt: A tiny armored placoderm hatchling silhouetted against a bright modern coral reef and sunlit blue water, a transition from ancient dark to modern light
shots.i2v_prompt: light blooms as the view rises toward the reef, the small hatchling drifts upward

shots.still_prompt: Wide modern cold ocean, schools of sleek silver fish and a distant shark silhouette, shafts of light through cold blue water, pristine but quietly threatening
shots.i2v_prompt: schools sweep past, the distant shark silhouette glides across frame, slow camera drift

shots.still_prompt: Macro of a tiny vulnerable juvenile Dunkleosteus drifting alone in cold dark teal water, faint bioluminescent specks, eerie and small
shots.i2v_prompt: the hatchling drifts, bioluminescent specks float past, a gentle sway

shots.still_prompt: Extreme cold blue-teal water, the small armored hatchling almost motionless, a breath-like plume of particles, ominous calm
shots.i2v_prompt: slow cold drift, particles rise, a faint tremor runs through the hatchling

shots.still_prompt: A juvenile armored Dunkleosteus cruising low over a dark cold seafloor, teal documentary light, instinctive and wary
shots.i2v_prompt: the juvenile cruises low, fins working, camera tracks alongside it

shots.still_prompt: Dark cold water with a faint enormous shape stirring at the far edge of visibility behind the small Dunkleosteus, dread, depth
shots.i2v_prompt: the far shape shifts slightly in the gloom, the small Dunk goes still, tension rises

shots.still_prompt: A sleek fast modern silver predator fish knifing through dark teal water toward camera, sense of speed and motion
shots.i2v_prompt: the fish darts in fast with motion blur, then banks and circles

shots.still_prompt: Tight on the calm armored eye and slightly parted bony jaw of the young Dunkleosteus, coiled and motionless, prey reflected in the eye, quiet menace
shots.i2v_prompt: the eye fixes on the prey, the jaw parts a fraction, everything goes still

shots.still_prompt: A young Dunkleosteus mouth exploding open to vacuum water and a fish inside, a suction vortex, bubbles and scales scattering, the bony blades meeting, dramatic apex strike
shots.i2v_prompt: the mouth snaps open, a suction vortex pulls water and the fish in, then the bony blades clap shut once

shots.still_prompt: The young armored Dunkleosteus suspended in a single shaft of god-ray light, calm after the kill, particles drifting, serene yet powerful
shots.i2v_prompt: it hangs in the light, particles settle around it, a slow rotate

shots.still_prompt: An enormous dark predator shadow looming behind the small Dunkleosteus, far larger, approaching from the deep, cold dread, cinematic wide
shots.i2v_prompt: the giant shadow grows and resolves slightly, the small Dunk dwarfed beneath it

shots.still_prompt: Dramatic hero portrait of the Dunkleosteus facing camera, jaws agape, bony armor plates, god-rays raking down, a tiny diver-scale silhouette caught in the beam for scale, ominous money shot
shots.i2v_prompt: a slow menacing push toward the agape jaws, light rakes across the armor

shots.still_prompt: Pull back to a vast dark cold ocean with multiple looming predator silhouettes including a distant Megalodon shadow, open-ended series-finale energy
shots.i2v_prompt: the camera pulls back, silhouettes drift in the gloom, the dark deepens
